module: Flowgraph node "Get Crawl Results" (category repeat_instant, crawl). Reads the results of a finished crawl (bridge.getCrawlEndData). Outputs: time, points (penalties), damage, recoveries, completed, disqualified, pathnodeTimings (table). If the data is missing: node error and values at 0, false or {}.

work.desc: Copies the fields of getCrawlEndData to the output pins.
